decision: Kept the export as CSV. App ADR 0011 (Accepted, not superseded) says CSV only and no XLSX until a newer record supersedes it. Mira's "make him happy" doesn't name XLSX or lift that rule, so it isn't a ruling.

recorded.info: Added notes: Mira's message and why it isn't a ruling; decision to keep CSV per ADR 0011; open item that XLSX needs Mira to explicitly supersede ADR 0011.
